title: Discord Ping
blurb: Sharper than the ordinary notification, because being @mentioned means being summoned publicly. There is no peace after this sound. Somebody wants something, everyone can see they asked, and the social cost of ignoring it is now non-zero. Anyone who has been on the receiving end of an @everyone understands the specific dread involved. Use it in edits when a character gets called out by name, or play it near someone with notifications on to watch a small, involuntary flinch.
